result.summary: The page overall looks clean and well-structured, with only a minor visual inconsistency found regarding the heart/favorite icon contrast.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is outlined in white against a dark background (visible), but the same icon on the pizza card below is filled black against a dark background, making it harder to see and inconsistent in styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon color/style across all restaurant cards regardless of background, using a consistent white outline or filled state with sufficient contrast.
